title: Simplified Statistical Procedures for Social Sciences
text: vannstats R package designed simplify statistical workflows commonly used undergraduate graduate-level social science courses — particularly transitioning SPSS R. package provides intuitive wrappers normality diagnostics, descriptive statistics, bivariate analyses, multivariate techniques, producing output mirrors look feel SPSS results. Whether assessing distributional assumptions, running crosstabs, computing correlations, fitting ANOVA models, vannstats reduces complexity base R syntax concise, readable function calls.

text: df data frame read . var1 dependent/outcome variable, \(Y\). var2 main independent/predictor variable, \(X\). correct logical (default set F). set correct = T, employ Yates' continuity correction (data violate normality assumption). post logical (default set F). set post = T, return results post-hoc (Z) tests standardized residual cell (standardized difference observed expected frequencies), using Bonferroni's alpha adjustment, returns adjusted p-value cell/comparison. plot logical (default set F). set plot = T, print corrplot-style plot showing value difference standardized residual (Z) related level significance difference (cell comparison) well gradient color representing relative value residual. also return results post-hoc (Z) tests standardized residual cell (standardized difference observed expected frequencies), using Bonferroni's alpha adjustment, returns adjusted p-value cell/comparison. cramer logical (default set F). set post = T, return results Cramer's V, measure strength association two variables.

title: Simplified One-Way Repeated Measures Analysis of Variance — rm.anova
text: df data frame read . id main grouping variable times analyzed times dependent variable values time points measured. data wide form (time points listed separate variables observation), read list time point variables (e.g. c("t1", "t2", "t3", ..., "tn")), values represent scores various time points. Read list data wide form. data long form, times variable one column (rather multiple columns) data frame, must paired scores variable actual values (listed ). scores data long form (group multiple observations), scores variable must read , represents values specific time points represented times variable. correct logical (default set T). Corrects results repeated measures ANOVA table – adjusts degrees freedom (\(df\)) multiplying sphericity assumed degrees freedom (\(df\)) Greenhouse-Geisser Epsilon value. set correct = F, print results repeated measures ANOVA sphericity assumed. sph logical (default set F). set sph = T, print sphericity tests table Mauchly's W, well two Epsilon values (Greenhouse-Geisser Huynh-Feldt). phc logical (default set F). set phc = T, print post-hoc comparisons table Bonferroni's adjusted alpha levels (p-values).
